title: 〜気味 / 〜ぎみ
simpleExplanation: 〜気味 describes a slight, current condition, usually one you don't want: 風邪気味 = a touch of a cold, 太り気味 = putting on a bit of weight. It works like a noun/な-adjective (気味だ, 気味の, 気味で).
whenUsed: Talking about health, mood, and progress. Common: 疲れ気味, 緊張気味, 遅れ気味, 不足気味, 上がり気味.
formation: Followed by だ / の + Noun / で

rows.label: 風邪をひきがち
cells: 冬は風邪をひきがちだ

examples.ja: 風邪気味なので、今日は早く帰ります。
examples.reading: かぜぎみなので、きょうははやくかえります。
examples.en: I have a slight cold, so I'll go home early today.
examples.note: N + 気味: a slight cold today.

examples.reading: さいきん、すこしふとりぎみだ。
examples.en: I've been putting on a bit of weight recently.
examples.note: V-ます + 気味: a bit heavier lately.

examples.ja: 仕事が遅れ気味で、焦っている。
examples.reading: しごとがおくれぎみで、あせっている。
examples.en: Work is running a bit behind and I'm getting anxious.
examples.note: 遅れ気味で: running slightly behind.

examples.ja: 面接の前で、彼は少し緊張気味だった。
examples.reading: めんせつのまえで、かれはすこしきんちょうぎみだった。
examples.en: Before the interview, he was a little nervous.
examples.note: 緊張気味: slightly tense at that moment.

examples.ja: 最近、睡眠不足気味で、集中できない。
examples.reading: さいきん、すいみんぶそくぎみで、しゅうちゅうできない。
examples.en: I've been a bit short on sleep lately and can't concentrate.
examples.note: 気味で connects to a result.

similarGrammar.difference: A repeated tendency. 気味 is a present slight state.
Appearance or quality; 気味 is a condition.
Plain "a little"; 気味 makes it a compact description.

commonMistakes.wrong: 彼は遅刻気味だ。(intended: often late)
commonMistakes.why: A habit uses がち; 気味 would mean "slightly late right now".
Verbs attach with the ます stem.
気味 is for undesirable or neutral-negative states, not positive ones.

usageNotes: 気味 describes the present slight condition; がち describes a repeated tendency. Common: 疲れ気味, 緊張気味, 不足気味.
気味 is polite-sounding because it understates: 風邪気味で is a common reason for leaving early.
jlptTips: Present slight condition + 最近 / 今日は / ちょっと = 気味.
General tendency + よく / いつも / 〜すると = がち. This pair is tested together.
Words like 疲れ, 風邪, 太り, 遅れ, 緊張 before the blank strongly suggest 気味.
